thread:
Sam: following up from the PM postmortem 15: we need a short action plan for alert noise: owners, small rollout windows, and verification steps.

Jenna: I'll own auth-service alerts (auth-err-*, auth-latency-*). Proposal: bump error-rate threshold for 1xx->5xx noise by 2x, add 4m burst suppression, and monitor 24h. Target: PR by Tue, rollout Wed.

Harish: I'll do a dedupe sweep across infra-* rules. Suggest default dedupe window 6m for metric flaps, and add an escalation rule if incidents >3 in 90m. Will run tests in staging Fri morning.

Priya: I'll update the paging policy doc: P0/P1 always page, P2s go to ticket unless customer-affecting tag present. Also adding a suppression-review checklist. PR by Wed.

Sam: add short smoke test before prod rollout: replay two short spikes and confirm page for sustained failures. Example harness below:

```
# smoke: generate two 30s error bursts
for run in 1 2; do seq 1 80 | xargs -n1 -P10 curl -sS https://staging/auth/health || echo bad; sleep 30; done
```

Jenna: copying that, will post canary logs in the task.

oncall-bot: created task INFR-2567 "Auth alerts: thresholds + suppression" assigned to Jenna, due 2026-04-05.

Harish: note  implementation caveat: dedupe change needs exporter patch (alert-exporter v1.4). I'll coordinate with infra-deploy.

Sam: okay owners/times: Jenna thresholds by Wed PR, canary Wed PM, prod Fri; Harish dedupe tests Fri AM; Priya runbook Wed. Add verification notes to the task before close.

Priya: will also add a rollback clause: if suppressed alerts mask >2 real issues in 24h, auto-revert suppression and notify SRE.

Sam: perfect. tagging @incident-review for visibility. End.
